rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for establishing communication with a person or organization.

example.english: We will contact the organizer to confirm the registration details.
example.traditional: 我哋會聯絡主辦單位確認報名資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 lyun4 lok3 zyu2 baan6 daan1 wai6 kok3 jan6 bou3 ming4 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the emphasis is on trying to reach or get hold of someone.

example.english: Contact me if anything comes up.
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 si6 zau6 wan2 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for having or maintaining communication with someone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3

rows.note: Use this for the person designated to handle questions or communication.

example.english: Contact the contact person if you have any questions.
example.jyutping: jau5 man6 tai4 zau6 wan2 lyun4 lok3 jan4 laa1

rows.note: Use this for physical contact or touching between people or things.

example.english: They don't have much contact with each other.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 mou5 mat1 zip3 cuk1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a contact lens rather than ordinary spectacles.

example.english: I wear contact lenses, not glasses.
example.traditional: 我戴隱形眼鏡，唔戴眼鏡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 jan2 jing4 ngaan5 geng3 m4 daai3 ngaan5 geng3
